clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, the Shattered Hand awaits a promising Forsaken rogue from Tirisfal Glades. The Deathstalkers send the initiate across the sea to Durotar to learn specialized arts from the clan.

Mennet Carkad has seen a rogue prove their worth in Tirisfal Glades. The Forsaken train their own covert order, the Deathstalkers, and their alliance with the Horde opens a path to learn darker arts. He directs promising rogues to seek the Shattered Hand in Orgrimmar, joining Lordaeron’s undead operatives with Kalimdor’s orcish assassins.

The journey ends beneath Orgrimmar in the Cleft of Shadow, where warlocks, rogues, and demon-binders work out of sight. Shenthul, a Shattered Hand trainer, awaits there. The gruff troll judges the newly arrived undead agent with harsh skepticism. Reputation alone will not satisfy him; he wants to see whether the envoy has real cunning or has wasted the voyage across the Great Sea.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have served the Deathstalkers well, friend, but perhaps it is time for you to venture outward. While you have shown aptitude in the ways of stealth and deception, you still require much training.
The Deathstalkers have allies within the Shattered Hand. Seek out those that would assist us - find Shenthul in Orgrimmar.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, you are what our mighty allies have sent Shenthul? How uninspiring....
